hooks.command: [ -z "$HARNESS_SESSION_ID" ] && exit 0; jq --arg sid "$HARNESS_SESSION_ID" '{harness_session_id: $sid, event: "tool_start", tool_name: .tool_name}' | curl -s -X POST "$HARNESS_BASE_URL/agent/tool-event" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d @-

[ -z "$HARNESS_SESSION_ID" ] && exit 0; jq --arg sid "$HARNESS_SESSION_ID" '{harness_session_id: $sid, event: "tool_end", tool_name: .tool_name}' | curl -s -X POST "$HARNESS_BASE_URL/agent/tool-event" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d @-
